errors.name: InvalidCoreContract
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when Core is not a deployed 6529Stream Core.

errors.name: InvalidAdminContract
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the admin dependency is not a StreamAdmins contract.

errors.name: InvalidRecordFamilyRegistry
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the family classifier is not the required deployed registry.

errors.name: FunctionAdminUnauthorized
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when caller lacks global or target-scoped function authority.

errors.name: MetadataMutationPaused
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when preservation mutation pause is active.

errors.name: CollectionDoesNotExist
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the collection has not been created in Core.

errors.name: InvalidCollectionRecord
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when required record identity fields are zero.

errors.name: InvalidHashRef
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a hash reference is malformed or uses an unsupported algorithm.

errors.name: PreservationURITooLarge
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when a preservation URI exceeds launch limits.

errors.name: CollectionRecordAlreadyExists
errors.natspec: @notice Reverts when the same record hash has already been stored.

events.name: PreservationAdminContractUpdated
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when the admin dependency changes.

events.name: CollectionRecordRecorded
events.natspec: @notice Emitted when a generic collection preservation record is stored.

functions.name: streamCore
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the Core contract this preservation module extends.

functions.name: recordFamilyRegistry
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the immutable exact record-family classifier/authority host.

functions.name: streamModuleSchemaHash
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the launch schema hash for this module.

functions.name: streamModuleSupersedes
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the immediate predecessor module, or zero for the first version.

functions.name: recordCollectionRecord
latestCollectionRecordHash
functions.natspec:
@notice Returns the latest recorded hash for one collection/type/subject key.
 @dev Latest is last-write-wins by record time, not max `effectiveAt`.

functions.name: collectionRecordSummary
functions.natspec: @notice Returns the stored summary for a record hash.

functions.name: collectionRecord
functions.natspec:
@notice Returns the full stored payload for a record hash.
 @dev Signature fields are hash commitments only; this contract does not verify signatures.

functions.name: deriveCollectionRecordHash
functions.natspec: @notice Computes the domain-separated record hash without writing.

definition.name: IStreamPreservationRecords
definition.natspec: @notice Interface for outside-Core collection preservation and provenance records.
